description: Redeem an email-verification token. The token is the proof of mailbox ownership, so no session is required — deliberately diverging from upstream ATProto, because under EMAIL_VERIFICATION_POLICY=require-for-login an unverified user cannot create the session upstream assumes. A presented session must belong to the account being verified.

email.description: The address the token was issued for.

token.description: The token from the verification link.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: Token is invalid or already used. Tokens burn on any redemption attempt.

errors.name: ExpiredToken
errors.description: Token expired (24h TTL); request a new one.

errors.name: InvalidEmail
errors.description: The token was not issued for this address, the account's email changed since it was issued, or the presented session belongs to a different account.
